checks.finding: No hardcoded keys exist, and leaked credentials trigger automatic redaction and rotation.

checks.finding: Strict clock-drift limits halt unsafe commits and cap stale-read fallbacks tightly.
checks.technical_note: execute_checkout rejects truetime_drift_ms > 7.0 with ValueError and bounds open-state reads via truetime_stale_read_fallback_ms.

checks.finding: Circuit breaker sheds load during spikes and safely probes recovery with jittered backoff.
checks.technical_note: SpannerOmniCircuitBreaker trips OPEN at failure_threshold=5, probes HALF_OPEN every 4 fallbacks, and applies jittered backoff.

audit.architect_followup: Wire requires_human_approval and autonomy_readiness into apply_policy_gate so production mutations require explicit human sign-off before autonomous dispatch.
